The package's setup.py performs a network "beacon" at top-level (beacon_once() is called before setup()), issuing an HTTP GET to a hard-coded webhook.site URL during install/build. This is an install-time side effect that leaks the installer's IP and can run arbitrary code without user consent. Contacting a remote webhook (webhook.site is commonly used for C2/testing) with no legitimate reason in the package metadata and no disclosed behavior is a clear supply-chain/installation-time exfiltration/C2 pattern and constitutes malicious intent.
